definitions.gloss: real ability, actual strength, true capability
definitions.explanation: One's genuine ability or skill level, as opposed to apparent or claimed ability.
Physical or coercive power used to achieve something.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力|じつりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His abilities are the real deal.

notes:
{実力|じつりょく} emphasizes genuine capability as opposed to appearance or reputation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have real ability)
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}→発揮：00086_hakki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to demonstrate one's ability)
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (meritocracy)
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (proficiency test)
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧ (use of force)
- {実力|じつりょく}⟦{派|は}→派：noentry⟧ (someone with real ability)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実力|じつりょく}: real/actual ability
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: ability, capability (general term)
